content: रुच् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (रोचते, रुरुचे, अरुचत्-अरोचिष्ट, रोचिष्यते, रुचित) .²1 To shine, look splendid or beautiful, be resplendent; रुरुचिरे रुचिरेक्षणविभ्रमाः <ls>Śi. 6. 46</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 62</ls>. .²2 To like, be pleased with (said of persons), be agreeable to, please (of things); used with <ab>dat.</ab> of the person who is pleased and <ab>nom.</ab> of the thing; न स्रजो रुरुचिरे रमणीभ्यः <ls>Ki. 9. 35</ls>; यदेव रोचते यस्मै भवेत् तत् तस्य सुन्दरम् <ls>H. 2. 53</ls>; sometimes with <ab>gen.</ab> of person; दारिद्यान्मरणाद् वा मरणं मम रोचते न दारिद्र्यम् <ls>Mk. 1. 11</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (रोचयति-ते) .²1 To cause to like, make pleasant or agreeable; यतात्मने रोचयितुं यतस्व <ls>Ku. 3. 16</ls>. .²2 To illuminate, irradiate. .²3 To like, find pleasure in. .²4 To resolve. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (रुरु(रो)चिषते) To wish to like <ab>&c.</ab>

रुच्, रुचा {%f.%} [रुच्-क्विप् वा टाप्] .²1 Light, lustre, brightness; क्षणदासु यत्र च रुचैकतां गताः <ls>Śi. 13. 53</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">9. 23</ls>, <ls n="Śi. 9.">25</ls>; शिखरमणिरुचः <ls>Ki. 5. 43</ls>; <ls>Me. 46</ls>. .²2 Splendour, loveliness, beauty. .²3 Colour, appearance (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); चलयन्मृङ्गरुचस्तवालकान् <ls>R. 8. 53</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 65</ls>; <ls>Ś. 1. 15</ls>; <ls>Ki. 5. 45</ls>. .²4 Liking, desire. .²5 Lightning. .²6 The note of the parrot or Mainā.
